notes: The admission page https://www.gtk.uni-pannon.hu/en/admission/ describes only Spring 2027 admission for Master's programmes, so no intake dates for the Bachelor programme were extracted. Documents required of international applicants are not named in the supplied pages (the programme page only links to an external application information page), so no documents fact is given.

note.fr: Un entretien d'admission (examen d'entrée oral) en ligne via MS Teams est requis; il évalue les connaissances, les compétences linguistiques et la motivation. Score minimum de 56 points sur 100.
note.en: An online entrance examination (oral interview) via MS Teams is required; it assesses background knowledge, language skills and motivation. Minimum score of 56 points out of 100.

evidence.quote: the applicant takes a professional entrance examination (interview) via MS Teams organised by the Admission Committee
